member.name: T:Afrowave.Toolbox.ExchangeHouse.Markdown.MarkdownIncrementalBlockScanner
member.summary: Projects a bounded forward-only Markdown line stream into non-overlapping source block spans without retaining the text of a complete code fence or paragraph. Designed for future disk indexing, not for direct rendering.
member.remarks: Only top-level ATX headings, fenced code, blank lines and plain paragraph runs are grouped. Lists and blockquotes are emitted as opaque single-line spans, preventing premature claims of CommonMark-compatible containment. Inputs are already decoded; callers must validate an untrusted file in full before displaying any progressively scanned content to a terminal.

member.name: T:Afrowave.Toolbox.ExchangeHouse.Markdown.MarkdownIncrementalContainerScanner
member.summary: Incrementally recognizes explicit quote/list markers and the lifetime of top-level or quote-owned fences. Produces bounded per-line metadata for later container-aware Markdown block parsing.

member.summary: Forward-only bounded Markdown line scanner with top-level fence and heading state. It is an optional precursor to streaming block parsing, not a CommonMark parser.
